correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs all faces, derives the 91-generator spanning-tree edge presentation, checks all 180 triangular relators in an explicit permutation representation, enumerates the image group to order 120, and verifies surjectivity. The published Poincaré-sphere fundamental group also has order 120, making the representation faithful. Every one of the 231 nonfacial triangular loops is then proved to have order 10 and to lie in one inverse-stable conjugacy class of size 12.

evidence: Björner--Lutz introduce a 16-vertex Poincaré homology-sphere triangulation as an application of bistellar flips.
Lutz Section 1.5 gives the exact 90 facets, face vector, Poincaré-sphere identification, and trivial automorphism group.
Standard exact-object documentation records the fundamental group as the binary icosahedral group of order 120.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Those broader facts supply the object and the global group, but do not logically determine which three-edge loops are nontrivial, their orders, or their conjugacy distribution.

evidence: Knowing \(\pi_1\cong 2I\) only gives the ambient group and does not determine images of particular graph cycles.

Knowing the triangulation has trivial automorphism group cannot imply transitivity of its shortest loops; indeed the one-class phenomenon is a homotopy statement rather than a simplicial-symmetry statement.
The exact finite verifier supplies the missing inclusion-sensitive map from each of the 231 loops into the ambient group.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new conclusion requires faithful evaluation of every candidate loop and comparison of their conjugacy classes. None of the inspected prior global invariants implies those data.

value.rationale: Because the Poincaré homology sphere has trivial first homology, shortest essential loops are invisible to abelian homology and probe genuinely nonabelian topology. The result completely classifies the first possible simple-loop layer and finds a strong structural concentration into one order-10 free-homotopy type, despite the triangulation itself having no nontrivial simplicial automorphism.
